k.v: स्त्रियां बहुष्वप्सरसः स्वर्वेश्या उर्वशीमुखाः। घृताची मेनका रम्भा उर्वशी च तिलोत्तमा। सुकेशीमञ्जुघोषाद्याः कथ्यम्तेऽप्सरसो बुधैः। हाहा हूहूश्चैवमाद्या गन्धर्वास्त्रिदिवौकसाम्.।

s: puM, (maYjurmanoharo GozaH Sabdo'sya .) pUrvvajinaBedaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ upAsyadevatAviSezaH । asya mantrAdi yaTA, -- “jAqyOGatimiraDvaMsI saMsArArRavatArakaH । SrImaYjuGozo jayatAM sADakAnAM suKAvahaH ॥” tatrAgamottare । “mAtfkAdi samudDatya vahnibIjaM samudDaret । vAmAMsaM kUrmmasaMjYaYca tato mezeSamudDaret ॥ mIneSaYca tataH kuryyAt vAmanetrendusaMyutam । zaqakzaro manuH prokto maYjuGozasya SamBunA ॥ iyastu dIpanI proktA mUlamantrastu kaTyate । aNkuSaM SaktibIjaYca ramAbIjaM tataH priye ! ॥ bIjatrayAtmako mantro jAqyOGaDvAntanASanaH । SaktibIjaM ramAbIja kAmabIjaM taTA priye ! ॥ vidyA SrutiDarI proktA ezA varRatrayAtmikA । hakAro vahnimArUQo bAlanetrenduBUzitaH । proktA sArvvajYavidyeyaM ekavarRAtmikA priye ! ॥ sidDaH sADyaH susidDo vA sADakasya ripuSca vA । tadA mantro BavedBaktyA SuBado budDvido Bavet ॥ maDyAhne salile cEva Bojane BAjane taTA । gomaye tu bahirddeSe mETune ramaRIkuce ॥ gozWe ca niSi gomuRqe yantraM qamarusanniBam । viliKya mantravarRAMSca triSa UrdDve aDastaTA । liKeccandanaleKanyA prayatnAt sADakottamaH । uccAwane liKedyantraM gocarmmaRi viSezataH । salile vijayI nityaM Bajane ca maheSvaraH ॥ gomaye vAvadUkaH syAdgozWe sarvvajYatAM vrajet । kuce SrutiDaro nityaM gomuRqe ca mahAkaviH ॥ gomUtraM vadarImUlaM candanaM pAMSumeva ca । ekIkftyAzwaDA japtvA tilakaM DArayet sadA ॥ namaskftya varaM SrezWaM prArTayedBaktitatparaH । varaM prApya ca tasmAdvE viharettu yaTAsuKam ॥ nAnyadevArccanaM snAnaM praRavoccAraRaM na tu । vastrAYcalena dantAnAM SoDanaM lavaRena vA ॥ rAtrivAso na muYceta na SuciH syAt kadAcana । evaM kftvAM prayatnena jYAtvA gurumuKAt suDIH ॥ mAsEkena kavIndraH syAt dvimAsenEva ISvaraH । triBirmAsErBavenmartyaH sarvvaSAstraviSAradaH ॥ puttrArTI laBate puttraM DanArTI vipulaM Danam । AyurArogyakAmastu sarvvAn kAmAnavApnuyAt ॥ tataH karANganyAsO । kzAM SAM aNguzWAByAM namaH । ityAdi evaM hfdayAdizu । taTA ca tantre । “sambarttako vakeSaSca dvO varRO kaTitO priye ! । zaqdIrGaBAgmyAmetAByAM zaqaNgAni samAcaret ॥ sambarttaH kzakAraH vakeSaH SakAraH ॥ * ॥ DyAnam । “SaSaDaramiva SuBraM KaqgapustANgapARiM suruciramatiSAntaM paYcacUqaM kumAram । pfTutaravaramuKyaM padmapatrAyatAkzaM kumatidahanadakzaM maYjuDozaM namAmi ॥ pIWapUjAM tataH kuryyAdADArAdyAdiSaktitaH । BUtapretAdiBiH kuryyAt pIWAsanamanantaram ॥ jYAnadAtre namaH pAdyaM budDikartre taTAcamam । jAqyanASAya ganDaH syAdarGyaM syAd yakzapAya vE ॥ sarvvasidDipradAyeti puzpaM dadyAdvicakzaRaH । kundapuzpaM samAdAya BEravAn pUjayettataH ॥ asitANgo ruruScaRqaH kroDa unmattasaMjYakaH । kapAlI BIzaRaScEva saMhAraScAzwamaH smftaH ॥ tato DUpAdikaM dattvA prasUnAni bisarjayet । tEH puzpEH pUjayedazwO yakziRISca viSezataH ॥ surArisundarI cEva manohAriRyanantaram । kanakAvatI taTA kAmeSvarI ca ratikaryyaTa ॥ padminI ca nawI cEva anurAgiRyanantaram । pUjyA etAstu yoginyo hflleKAbIjapUrvvikAH ॥ evaM saMpUjya deveSaM lakzazawkaM japenmanum । GftAktakundapuzpESca ekAdaSaSatAni ca ॥ juhuyAdeDite vahnO kAntAre pitfveSmani । evaM sidDamanurmantrI mahAyogISvaro Bavet ॥” iti tantrasAraH ॥ prakArAntaraM kukkuwAditantre drazwavyam ॥
